title: Spectrum Estimator
text: Estimate power spectrum or power-density spectrum, 1 input, 5 outputs, {Power units} sets Power units; {Method} sets the welch or filter, {Number of taps per band} sets the number of filter taps per frequency band, {Spectrum type} sets the type of spectrum, {Frequency resolution method}, {RBW (Hz)} sets the resolution bandwidth, {Window length source} sets the source of window length Same as input frame, {Window length}, {Number of bands source} sets the source of number of frequency bands Same as input frame, {Number of bands} sets the number of frequency bands, {FFT length source} sets the source of FFT length value, {FFT length}, {Inherit sample rate from input}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Window function}, {Sidelobe attenuation of window (dB)}, {Averaging method}, {Number of spectral averages}, {Specify forgetting factor from input port}, {Forgetting factor}, {Window overlap (%)} sets the percentage of overlap between windows, {Reference load (ohms)}, {Frequency range}, {Output max-hold spectrum}, {Output min-hold spectrum}, {Output frequency vector}, {Output effective RBW} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
